notes.title: The Update I didn't expect
notes.content:
Just now added about 400 new words for the easy difficulty and about 300 for hard difficulty.

This is because a couple of people said that this was the one change they wanted. It's pretty funny from a development point of view because it's the easiest thing to add. In fact with pretty much all the content that I've made so you can import your own, it would have been way easier to just add it myself than try and make it work with custom assets. For example, adding these words took at most half an hour, whereas adding the ability to add your own words took the best part of a day (and would have taken longer if not for having already spent easily more than a week full time on the importer).

I did it this way because, even though it meant I had to do more work, I thought people would enjoy being able to use their own stuff too. That's why I focused the rest of my time on things people wouldn't be able to add themselves - the interface, gameplay options, and game modes. I was so concerned with making the complex parts work well it never occured to me that the one gripe anyone would have would be this.

notes.title: Summer Update Is Out
notes.content:
The summer update for Type Up is out right now, including UI and graphical improvements, bug fixes, and more ways to modify your game, just to start. For a quick look at the major changes here's a video showcasing many of the changes.

[previewyoutube=pnnarHzf3L8;full][/previewyoutube]

To see all the ingame changes just boot up the game, this update is completely free. For more on importing assets, Tutorial videos on the new things you can import will be uploaded when they're ready, the links on the character creation video have already been updated with the new version of the asset bundler that works with previous and new versions. See the official youtube channel for the game for that and more.

notes.title: Upcoming: custom backgrounds/settings/worlds
notes.content:
Just like how the game let's you import your own characters, with the next update you will also be able to also import your own background/world/setting/whatever you want to call it. This will work with an almost identical process as with character models.
You can also see the interface is changed not just from the current release but even since the last announcement, and will continue to be improved.
If you have any improvements or additions you'd like to say make sure to say something here or @ the official twitter account.
